metadata.question: On June 24, 2025, was the peak observed temperature in St. Francis, Kansas higher than Death Valley, California?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need temperature data for June 24, 2025 - Two locations: St. Francis, Kansas and Death Valley, California - Use MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) which provides daily temperature data - Collection: MODIS/061/MOD11A1 (Terra) or MYD11A1 (Aqua) for daily LST 2. Masking strategy: - Use QC bands to mask poor quality pixels - Temperature is the focus, not clouds 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid temperature should be in reasonable range (e.g., -50°C to 70°C) - Convert from Kelvin to Celsius (MODIS LST is in Kelvin * 0.02) - Check if result is None/NaN → C3 - Check if no images found → C1 - Check if no valid pixels after masking → C2 - Compare temperatures: St. Francis > Death Valley → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const stFrancis = ee.Geometry.Point([-101.8, 39.77]); // St. Francis, Kansas const deathValley = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.82, 36.51]); // Death Valley, California const date = '2025-06-24'; // 2. Data Acquisition const modis = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']); const modisSize = modis.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS images found: ${modisSize}`); if (modisSize === 0) { console.log("No MODIS data available for June 24, 2025"); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing function function maskLST(image) { const qc = image.select('QC_Day'); const mask = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); // Good quality pixels return image.select('LST_Day_1km').updateMask(mask); } const img = modis.map(maskLST).mean(); // 4. Calculate temperatures for both locations const stFrancisStats = img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: stFrancis.buffer(1000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const deathValleyStats = img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: deathValley.buffer(1000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stFrancisCount = stFrancisStats.LST_Day_1km_count || 0; const deathValleyCount = deathValleyStats.LST_Day_1km_count || 0; console.log(`St. Francis valid pixels: ${stFrancisCount}`); console.log(`Death Valley valid pixels: ${deathValleyCount}`); if (stFrancisCount === 0 || deathValleyCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after masking"); console.log("C2"); return; } const stFrancisLST = stFrancisStats.LST_Day_1km_mean; const deathValleyLST = deathValleyStats.LST_Day_1km_mean; // 5. Validation & Convert to Celsius if (stFrancisLST == null || deathValleyLST == null || isNaN(stFrancisLST) || isNaN(deathValleyLST)) { console.log("Temperature calculation failed"); console.log("C3"); return; } const stFrancisTemp = stFrancisLST * 0.02 - 273.15; const deathValleyTemp = deathValleyLST * 0.02 - 273.15; console.log(`St. Francis temperature: ${stFrancisTemp.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Death Valley temperature: ${deathValleyTemp.toFixed(2)}°C`); // Validate reasonable temperature range if (stFrancisTemp < -50 || stFrancisTemp > 70 || deathValleyTemp < -50 || deathValleyTemp > 70) { console.log("Temperature out of reasonable range"); console.log("C3"); return; } // 6. Final Answer if (stFrancisTemp > deathValleyTemp) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
